dimensions.assessment: Directly impacts federal agencies tasked with updating official documents and maps, and broadly affects public and private users of official federal geographic records.
dimensions.evidence: the head of each Federal agency shall update each document and map of the Federal agency in accordance with the renaming

dimensions.assessment: Primarily administrative renaming of a geographic feature across federal documents and maps.
dimensions.evidence: directs federal agencies to update their documents and maps to incorporate the new name.

dimensions.assessment: The source material does not specify federal spending or economic costs associated with updating maps and documents.
Amends federal references, maps, and regulations regarding a specific geographic landmark via executive agency implementation.
dimensions.evidence: Any reference in a law, map, regulation, document, paper, or other record of the United States to the Gulf of Mexico shall be deemed to be a reference to the Gulf of America

dimensions.assessment: Permanent statutory change to the name, implemented through a one-time federal document update required within 180 days.
dimensions.evidence: Not later than 180 days after the date of the enactment of this section, the head of each Federal agency shall update each document and map

missing_information: Estimates of federal costs to update maps and documents.
importance_detail.rationale: The bill officially changes the geographic name of the Gulf of Mexico to the Gulf of America and requires federal agencies to update documents and maps accordingly within 180 days.
